target_units.train: Original record envelope cast float32 then float64, same inherited window-cache values

projection.centering: Within each fixed covered physical60s block
projection.e: v-alpha*u; standard centered population variance/covariance; mean(e) reported
projection.r_aggregation: Evaluate identity blockwise, then block->person->phase; never plug average alpha into nonlinear identity

undefined_policy: Nonfinite/zero variance explicit None, person preserved; any missing metric makes that full-person/phase metric undefined; no epsilon/ridge or row dropping
low_variance_policy: var<=64*float64_eps*mean(x^2) flags only; positive finite denominators still computed, no exclusions

gradients.phase: TRAIN only, once per seed at frozen anchor
gradients.coordinates: Predicted window p before raw residual factor0.1; same i>=9 learnability mask
gradients.gM: 2*(anchor_window-y_float32)/(252454*192); all original windows including fallback constants in denominator; not online SGD/Adam gradient
gradients.adjoint: For every original record, scatter physical gradients of all fixed blocks, then h[t]/weight[96i+t] for each window coordinate, finally i>=9 mask
gradients.aggregation: Sum squared norms/dots, then cosine; record/person distributions retained, not average cosines
gradients.angular_identity: P_perp gF=(2*norm(u)*norm(yc)/n)*gR before Hann; positive scale, no intrinsic single-block angular conflict
gradients.fallback: i<9 constant derivative zero; partial tails/outside eligible blocks have gF/gR0 but gM retains192-point supervision including zero-Hann endpoints

scientific_status: Fixed diagnostic, not a learned model or causal optimization inference
